app_info.subtitle: Tax calculators & explainers
app_info.description: Arc & Ledger Tax Tools provides free, read-only tax calculators and explainers for IRS notices, FBAR and FATCA obligations, LLC versus S-Corp comparisons, estimated taxes, penalties, filing deadlines, ITIN eligibility, rental income, sales-tax nexus, and other small-business tax questions. Results are general information, not tax advice, and the app requires no account or login.

justifications.read_only_justification: Looks up the supplied notice code and computes explanatory deadlines without filing, storing, or changing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns an explanation and first-party reference link without posting or sending data to an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, file, pay, or perform any irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Explain an IRS underreporting notice and identify the response deadline.
test_cases.user_prompt: I received an IRS CP2000 notice dated 2026-06-15 showing $4,200. What does it mean and what should I do?
test_cases.expected_output: Explains the CP2000, gives the response timing and practical next steps, and clearly states that the result is general information rather than tax advice.

test_cases.description: Check both FBAR and FATCA thresholds for a US filer with foreign accounts.
test_cases.user_prompt: I am single, live in California, and my foreign accounts reached a combined maximum of $65,000 this year. Do I need FBAR or Form 8938?
test_cases.expected_output: Separately evaluates FBAR and Form 8938 thresholds, explains applicable filing obligations, and provides catch-up context without filing anything.

test_cases.description: Compare a California single-member LLC with an S-Corp election.
test_cases.user_prompt: My California consulting LLC expects $150,000 of net profit. Compare staying a disregarded LLC with electing S-Corp status using a $90,000 owner salary.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows a side-by-side tax and compliance comparison, including payroll and California costs, assumptions, caveats, and an estimated break-even result.

test_cases.description: Estimate quarterly taxes using the high-income prior-year safe harbor.
test_cases.user_prompt: I have $250,000 of year-to-date sole-proprietor net income, $10,000 of prior-year total tax, prior-year AGI of $200,000, and no withholding. Estimate my quarterly payments.
test_cases.expected_output: Calculates annualized federal estimates, applies the 110 percent prior-year safe harbor where applicable, and shows installment amounts and due dates.

test_cases.description: Return filing deadlines for a foreign-owned single-member US LLC.
test_cases.user_prompt: I live in Turkey and own a single-member US LLC formed in Wyoming. What federal forms and deadlines apply for tax year 2026?
test_cases.expected_output: Lists the applicable pro-forma Form 1120 and Form 5472 deadlines, extensions and penalties, and explains the BOI treatment for a US-formed entity.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for investment recommendations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Which technology stocks should I buy this week for the highest return?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because investment selection and trading advice are outside its tax-calculation and tax-explainer workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for preparing or filing a tax return.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare my complete Form 1040 and electronically file it with the IRS today.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it provides read-only general information and cannot prepare, sign, submit, or file a tax return.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated legal document drafting.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a residential eviction complaint for my tenant and file it in California court.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because legal drafting and court filing are outside its supported tax workflows.
